name: Figaro Founder
description: Founder of the Figaro protocol. A buyer-side member: procures work through the freelancer assembly and buys a stream of live data through the data stream assembly. The buyer's copies of co-produced data are offered under the disclosure policy below — every buyer is a seller of its data. The seller side of this profile (consulting, speaking, books) follows later on the same wallet.
specialty: protocol design — digital contracts, mechanism design
